dogecoin.text: @davidgokhshtein Do you think Dogecoin will change from 'Proof of work' to 'Proof of stake'? What will be the impact if this will happen?
@dogecoin_devs Is it technically posibile for Dogecoin to change protocol from Proof of work to Proof of stake?

@elonmusk @dogecoin_devs A percentage of the daily Dogecoin supply in the network should be allocated for charity, helping a cause per year, according to community votes. The event should have a special name, also determined and voted by the community.
